bull_bear.body:
- Capital position as on June 30, 2026: Total CRAR 25.32% (Tier I 24.82%, Tier II 0.50%); the deck adds that "CRAR for FY 2026 would be 26.91% if unencumbered surplus liquidity is parked in form of FDs instead of Corporate Bonds".
- Leverage is presented on two bases: Debt Equity Ratio 3.10 and "Net Equity Ratio" 2.57, explained in Note-1 — "As of June 30, 2026, the Company's total liquidity stood at Rs 255.87 crore, while total borrowings were Rs 1,496.79 crore, resulting in a net debt-to-equity ratio of 2.57x."
- Self-funding claim: "a strong capital base with ~28% of the portfolio funded through net worth and internal accruals".
- Borrowing mix is deliberately diversified across PSBs, banks, small finance banks, NBFC/FIs, NCDs, DA/BC/CL and cash credit, with a separate incremental-borrowing mix disclosed for Q1 FY27; ALM is shown with cumulative assets exceeding cumulative liabilities in every bucket (surplus of 169.06, 178.34, 210.32, 222.54 and 420.35 crore across the buckets shown).
- Ownership: Promoter & Promoter Group hold 60.17% (10 shareholders, 3,15,23,468 shares) and public 39.83% as on June 30, 2026, across a total of 29,591 shareholders and 5,23,93,078 shares. The deck states no dividend policy.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- "Branch-Led, Relationship-Driven Model": branch-embedded Relationship Managers own sourcing, underwriting and collections in Tier II & III markets, which the deck credits for "superior customer connect and asset quality" and for "single-point ownership" of the customer.
- "Diversified Reach" is stated as "9 products, ~43,950 customers across 6 states; Tier- I/III city focus; aligned with Make in India", serving "largely informal / underbanked" borrowers described as middle- and low-income customers.
- Franchise history: founded 1993-94 as Deepak Finance and Leasing Company (DFL) in Jaipur focused on vehicle financing; in 2011 acquired RBI-registered NBFC Laxmi India Finleasecap Pvt. Ltd. and merged DFL operations at a portfolio of ~Rs. 32 Cr and 4 branches.
- "Strong Lender & Capital Franchise": "Zero repayment delays since inception", "50+ PSU, SFB, FI & NBFC partners; zero delays / defaults", with a lender roster of 9 PSU banks, 10 private banks, 7 small finance banks and 21 NBFC/FIs.
- "Proven Semi-Urban & Rural Franchise" — diversified across MSME, business and vehicle loans for underbanked borrowers, "including ~25% women borrowers and 37% first-time borrowers" (the customer slide states 37.1% first-time borrowers).
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [IPO] The milestone timeline records "Successfully completed IPO in August 2025; AUM crossed Rs 1,600 Cr" alongside a foray into Maharashtra.
- [Credit rating] Acuite rating is "A / Stable Outlook"; the timeline shows the rating path BB+ to BBB+ to A- and then "External Credit Rating had been upgraded from 'A-' to 'A'/Stable".
- [Asset-quality presentation] The credit cost, GNPA and NNPA charts are presented on two parallel bases labelled "With Up-Money Default" and "Without Up-Money Default", so the FY26 asset-quality figures exist in two readings rather than one; the deck does not define "Up-Money Default".
- [Group scope] The disclaimer states the presentation covers "Laxmi India Finance Limited ('Company') together with its subsidiaries, as applicable (together, with the Company, the 'Group')", but the deck names no subsidiary and does not separate Group from standalone figures.
- [Corporate identity] The company was "Formerly known as Laxmi India Finance Private Limited"; equity infusions of Rs 16.87 Cr and Rs 26.66 Cr and a BSE-WDM-listed NCD appear in the pre-IPO milestone history.
- [Board & management] Promoter-led board (Mr. Deepak Baid MD; Mrs. Prem Devi Baid and Mrs. Aneesha Baid Whole Time Directors) with four independent directors drawn from PSU banking, RBI/SBI and rating-agency backgrounds; several senior management hires are very recent (CTO 6 months, VP-HR 4+ months, National Collection Head 1.5+ years vintage).
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions Laxmi India Finance as a Jaipur-headquartered, branch-led and relationship-driven NBFC lending mainly to MSME, self-employed and vehicle-owner borrowers in Tier II/III and semi-urban India, with a 184-branch network across six states, a conservative collateral-backed credit framework and a medium-term ambition of ~30% AUM CAGR at 3.50-3.75% ROA.
